title: Ukraine's Former Top General: Russia's Offensive Capability Is 'Broken'
detail: Ukraine's former commander-in-chief, General Valery Zaluzhny, told the BBC that Russia's offensive capability has been 'broken', suggesting Moscow is increasingly unable to sustain major advances. The assessment points to mounting attrition in Russian forces and signals a potential shift in the war's trajectory.

media.caption: Ukraine's former top general says Russia's offensive capability is 'broken'

title: Russia Launches Major Overnight Missile and Drone Strike on Kyiv
detail: Russia launched a major overnight missile and drone barrage targeting Kyiv. President Zelensky stated that allied partners gave no early warning before the attack, and that Russia did not heed US President Trump's ceasefire call. The strike underscores continued Russian offensive operations despite ongoing diplomatic pressure.

title: Ukraine Reports No Advance Intelligence Warning Before Russian Strikes for Two Consecutive Nights
detail: Ukraine reported it received no advance intelligence warning ahead of Russian strikes for two consecutive nights, raising concerns about gaps in Western intelligence-sharing with Kyiv. The disclosure follows major overnight missile and drone barrages targeting Ukrainian cities and underscores ongoing questions about allied support during active Russian offensive operations.

title: Russia Frames Energy Ceasefire as Economic Opportunity, Signals Diesel Export Restoration
detail: Russia signaled that diesel exports could return to pre-invasion levels if the Trump-brokered energy ceasefire deal holds, framing the arrangement as an economic opportunity for Moscow. The statement suggests Russia sees selective economic normalization as leverage in the broader negotiation landscape.
